column3: Rate limiter returns HTTP 200 OK status instead of standard HTTP 429 Too Many Requests
column5: Medium
column6: Next.js Server Action (`loginAction`)
column7:
1. Send 10+ rapid POST requests within 60s to https://studio.unfaa.com/auth/sign-in with Next-Action header.
2. Check the HTTP status code returned on the 10th attempt.
column8: Server should return HTTP Status Code 429 (Too Many Requests) with a standard Retry-After header so network proxies and CDNs recognize rate-limiting.
column9: Server returns HTTP 200 OK containing JSON error code 'TOO_MANY_REQUESTS'. Returning HTTP 200 hides the rate-limiting event from edge proxies.
